question: Does disabling only the low-support fallback mixture improve the already-opened code-target reasoning result relative to the unchanged full repaired bridge under identical data, compute, capacity, and authority budgets?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R6 package: structured+technical-prose training domains, 15,819 training bytes, 256 motifs, 8x32 reasoning classes, exact-context tables, 1,454-byte code target, depth-3 cap, and selected-query identity. Compare two frozen bridge variants only: BASELINE=B11 full repaired bridge; CANDIDATE=B01 exact-context enabled with low-support fallback disabled. No other bridge stage, relation table, capacity, class assignment, threshold, source, runtime cap, or evaluator changes. This is a mechanism counterfactual on the originating dataset only. It cannot be retained from R7 even if better; any candidate advantage must later transfer to a preregistered disjoint future dataset under equal budgets before retention.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; optimize future-dataset learning efficiency, not self-modification

prior_evidence.interpretation: The low-support fallback is the dominant causal factor in suppression on the frozen code-target queries.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.baseline: B11 full repaired bridge byte-identical R6
frozen_reuse.candidate: B01 exact-context=true, low-support-fallback=false byte-identical R6 factorial variant

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and the preregistered exact-context-only candidate improves total code-target exact hits by at least one without reducing selected-query exact hits or violating probability/accounting controls.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and the candidate changes class-5/6 competitive behavior or selected-query hits but does not improve total target exact hits by at least one.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes and the candidate yields no useful target improvement or worsens target exact hits.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, candidate identity, bridge identity, target identity, determinism, provenance, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

successor_if_supported.intent: test the exact frozen candidate versus no-change on a preregistered disjoint future dataset under identical data/compute/capacity/authority budgets; retain only if transfer advantage is supported

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute why removal changes internal competition without producing transferable task gain before proposing another mechanism

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter data, budgets, 256 capacity, classes, selected-query set, baseline/candidate bridge variants, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
